about.title: About Me
about.description: I’m a software engineer with 3+ years of experience as a full-stack developer. I design, build, and deploy robust, scalable web applications. I’m proud to lead projects end-to-end—from concept to production launch.

backend.title: Backend
backend.body: I specialize in backend development with PHP (Laravel v7–v12 and Livewire), JavaScript, and Python, applying MVC patterns, SOLID principles, and agile methodologies.

frontend.title: Frontend & SPA
frontend.body: I have experience building frontends, landing pages, and SPAs with Tailwind CSS, React, and Next.js.

database.title: Databases
database.body: Extensive experience in modeling, normalization, and optimization for MySQL and PostgreSQL.

mobile.title: Mobile
mobile.body: I also develop mobile applications with Flutter and React Native.

about.closing: My professional passion centers on leadership, teamwork, organization, and attention to detail. I continuously learn new tools and techniques in modern web development.

strappberry.title: Mobile Developer | Full Stack Developer
descriptionPoints: Develop web projects, backend systems, and REST APIs for mobile applications using the TALL Stack (Tailwind, Alpine, Laravel, Livewire).
Maintain and integrate new modules into legacy projects.
Design, normalize, and maintain SQL databases for production environments.
Build solutions for credit, fleet management, health, and fumigation sectors, among others.
Create interfaces with Livewire, Tailwind, and CSS, aligned with modern UX/UI principles.
Develop mobile apps with Flutter and React Native, published on Google Play and the App Store.
Perform daily deliveries, reviews, and follow-ups under the SCRUM methodology.
